c-gating-read-on-public.1.evidence: Walk Pub (id 6581, public/open). REST POST /spaces/6581/access-rules {logged_in|everyone, read} -> 201 no_effect:true, message 'Access rule added, but it changes nothing. This space is Public with an Open join policy ... set Who Can Post and Who Can Reply to Members Only on the General tab.'; admin UI Add Rule (Logged In + Read) reloads with toast of that exact text (captured from jetonomyAdminToast) and a standing .jt-access-warning 'An Everyone or Logged In rule here changes nothing.' on the Access Rules tab. PATCH to Participate gives 'Access rule updated, but it changes nothing...'.

c-gating-read-on-public.2.evidence: With the Read rule present, subscriber walkrule (not on roster) used the New Topic form on /community/s/walk-pub/new/ and posted 'What is the best phone for testing?' -> redirected to its topic page.

c-gating-read-on-public.3.evidence: walkrule on bob's topic with the rule present: Vote up -> POST /posts/13384/vote 200; Post Reply -> POST /posts/13384/replies 201.

c-gating-read-on-public.4.evidence: Roster member bob with the rule present: REST POST topic 201, reply 201 (vote on his own topic refused 400 jetonomy_self_vote, the normal own-content rule).

c-gating-read-on-public.5.evidence: Guest (user 0) GET /spaces/6581/posts -> 200 list while the Read rule exists; guest POST /posts/13384/replies -> 401 rest_not_logged_in. (Note: an earlier 404 for guests came from my fixture pointing at a non-existent category id 1, not from the rule; fixed to a real category.)

c-gating-read-on-public.6.evidence: Admin Access Rules tab: Delete -> confirm -> toast 'Access rule deleted.'; walkrule then POST topic 201 (still posts).

c-gating-read-on-public.7.evidence: walkrule POST /spaces/6581/access-rules -> 403 jetonomy_forbidden 'Only site administrators can manage access rules for this space.'; GET rules afterwards {data:[]} (nothing stored).
